oracleRisk.summary: SLVon Final Terms appoint the issuer and Ondo Finance as calculation agents and value issuance/redemption using broker-provided SLV prices and the attributable underlying units per token. Current Ondo Stocks pricing documentation says the investor quote is calculated using proprietary methodology, inventory, order size and market conditions. The displayed underlying ETF holdings and token price do not establish an independent SLVon redemption-price oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: SLVon is an issuer-valued secured tracker of SLV, not a borrower collateral/liquidation mechanism. Its issue and redemption price authority remains economically applicable even though no borrower liquidation branches exist.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: SLVon native GM issuance and separate EVM OndoOFT/HyperEVM representation remain distinct. Existing reciprocal peers, three-DVN configurations and mutable flow limits are retained. Final 2026-10-21 pins Ethereum26238146/BSC128863032/HyperEVM49100165 enumerate every declared BridgeRegistrar role: one factory, PAUSER via a 1-of-9 Safe, UNPAUSER via a 4-of-7 Safe, and DEFAULT_ADMIN via the chain's 7200-second timelock. Each timelock has self plus a 5-of-9 admin Safe, one 4-of-7 proposer, and executor/canceller rosters consisting of the 1-of-9 Safe plus code-empty 0xff1621ee754512b34a6bd62a941cc4d5e4d0b85b; none is an open zero-address role. All identified Safes have complete empty module pages and zero guards. Exact timelock source requires a queued ready operation for arbitrary CALL and self-call for delay changes; external default admins can change role membership without that queue. Registrar pause gates registration, not existing-token transfer. Separate OndoOwner root arbitrary superCall and mutable configuration persist. Native Solana source/build and proposal/bypass evidence is recorded in mintAuthority.executionScope, without asserting a complete arbitrary-CPI target envelope. Human signer/DVN custody, conserving liability materiality and remaining incident admission are separate unresolved obligations. Original review starts and observation pins remain unchanged; no tier or durable cap credit is promoted.

routes.reviewNote: At finalized Solana slot 439724580 on 2026-08-16, the SLVon Token-2022 mint authority remained Ondo's GM program PDA 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD. Ondo's GM API supports the native solana-900 mint path, and the Zellic GM Solana audit documents attestation-backed user minting and administrative mint_gm controls. The separate question of a Solana SLVon OFT adapter remains unresolved and is not used to demote this native route.

At HyperEVM block 43372762, SLVon on HyperEVM is minted solely by the OndoOFT contract 0x7b97e37f7ec5271ef24eb2a3c5bd1fcf308c2a85. The OFT owner() is 0x2e59565b98ec5339cb9767ddb903d9b1e2127e5d, endpoint() is the HyperEVM LayerZero V2 endpoint 0x3a73033c0b1407574c76bdbac67f126f6b4a9aa9, token() points to this deployment, and approvalRequired() is false. This is a bridge representation, not an independent native issuance chain. R1 source review 2026-10-09: the exact HyperEVM adapter is verified OndoOFT; canonical Ethereum verified _debit calls innerToken.burnFrom and _credit calls innerToken.mint. These are positive direct-burn/no-canonical-escrow paths, not a conclusion from an absent lockbox read. Issuer docs specify the same burn/mint architecture and destination token amount for Ethereum, BNB and HyperEVM. Solana remains independent native GM issuance, yielding four registered native/direct-burn liabilities with EVM 18 and Solana 9 decimals. Existing state pins and control questions retain their dates; no numeric supply share or census result is authored.
